data.name: Python FastAPI 构建
data.description: 使用 uv 构建 Python FastAPI 应用并推送 Docker 镜像
data.content:
version: v1
timeout: 3600

steps:
  - name: checkout
    uses: checkout
    with:
      depth: 1
    outputs:
      - commit_sha
    retry_policy: always_rerun

  - name: test
    depends_on: [checkout]
    timeout: 600
    steps:
      - name: lint
        image: python:{{ PYTHON_VERSION }}
        commands:
          - pip install uv
          - uv sync
          - uv run ruff check src/
          - uv run mypy src/

      - name: unit-test
        image: python:{{ PYTHON_VERSION }}
        commands:
          - pip install uv
          - uv sync
          - uv run pytest tests/ -v

  - name: build
    depends_on: [test]
    steps:
      - name: registry-login
        image: docker:latest
        volumes:
          - docker-config:/root/.docker
        commands:
          - docker login {{ REGISTRY }} -u {{ REGISTRY_USER }} -p {{ REGISTRY_PASSWORD }}

      - name: build-and-push
        depends_on: [registry-login]
        image: docker:latest
        volumes:
          - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
          - docker-config:/root/.docker
        commands:
          - docker build -t {{ REGISTRY }}/{{ IMAGE_NAME }}:{{ trigger_ref }} .
          - docker push {{ REGISTRY }}/{{ IMAGE_NAME }}:{{ trigger_ref }}
        artifacts:
          - type: docker_image
            name: "{{ REGISTRY }}/{{ IMAGE_NAME }}:{{ trigger_ref }}"
data.variable_declarations: [{"name": "PYTHON_VERSION", "description": "Python 版本", "required": false, "default": "3.12"}, {"name": "REGISTRY", "description": "镜像仓库地址", "required": true}, {"name": "REGISTRY_USER", "description": "镜像仓库用户名", "required": true}, {"name": "REGISTRY_PASSWORD", "description": "镜像仓库密码", "required": true}, {"name": "IMAGE_NAME", "description": "镜像名称", "required": true}]

        commands:
          - npm run lint

      - name: unit-test
        depends_on: [install]
        image: node:{{ NODE_VERSION }}
        commands:
          - npm run test

  - name: build
    depends_on: [test]
    steps:
      - name: registry-login
        image: docker:latest
        volumes:
          - docker-config:/root/.docker

        image: docker:latest
        volumes:
          - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock

        commands:
          - docker build -t {{ REGISTRY }}/{{ IMAGE_NAME }}:{{ trigger_ref }} .

data.name: 简单构建
data.description: 最简单的 CI 模板，仅包含 checkout 和 build 步骤
data.content:
version: v1
timeout: 1800

steps:
  - name: checkout
    uses: checkout
    with:
      depth: 1
    retry_policy: always_rerun

  - name: build
    depends_on: [checkout]
    image: {{ BUILD_IMAGE }}
    commands:
      - echo "Building project..."
      - {{ BUILD_COMMAND }}
data.variable_declarations: [{"name": "BUILD_IMAGE", "description": "构建镜像", "required": true, "default": "alpine:latest"}, {"name": "BUILD_COMMAND", "description": "构建命令", "required": true, "default": "echo 'Build completed'"}]
